text:
Lina: Quick UX review 1: can we make the sampler control smaller and tuck it into the heatmap toolbar? current layout feels noisy.
Pablo: Compact is fine but we need clear affordances for exact values. users often ask: what was the exact sample used for this snapshot?
Ruth: What if we show the selected value as a small pill next to the control, and expose an exact-value tooltip on focus? that keeps compactness but preserves precision.
Evan: Also think about time-range interactions: when user changes timepicker presets (Last 1h, 24h), sampler should persist per-panel or global? currently it resets and confuses people.
Kai: Strong +1 for per-panel persistence. sampling is analytic-view scoped. global changes are surprising.
Lina: Good call. proposal: sampler sits in heatmap toolbar, labeled "Sampling — view only", pill shows "5%" when set, tooltip shows exact fraction and a link "Why sampling?".
Pablo: Microcopy: prefer short phrase: "View sampled data (X% of requests). Not used for exports." maybe too legal?
Ruth: That last sentence might scare users. Keep neutral: "View sampled data (X% of requests). Exports include full data when available."
Evan: Accessibility notes: presets must be keyboard-focusable and at least 44x44 dp, ARIA role=button, aria-pressed for toggles, and the pill should have aria-describedby to the help text. Use aria-live for live numeric updates.
Kai: Visual: if sample < 3% do we show a confidence hint on p95? I'd rather show a subtle chevron icon on the p95 legend that opens a short modal: "Small sample sizes can affect high percentiles." with examples.
Lina: Modal might be heavy. Suggest inline inline micro-copy under the legend for low-sample rates + a subtle patterned overlay on the p95. pattern is important for colorblind users.
Pablo: Pattern options: stripes, dots, crosshatch. We should test on mono + deuteranopia simulators. Also ensure pattern + color meets 3:1 contrast at small sizes per WCAG where possible.
Ruth: For timepicker interaction: when sampling is applied per-panel, add a small toast when switching time range: "Sampling (5%) retained for this panel" with an undo CTA. keeps users informed.
Evan: Performance note from infra: we can precompute sampled buckets for common presets (1,5,10) to speed rendering. please add to design: transition state when switching presets (skeleton rows) to avoid jank.
Lina: UX flow to ship: 1) move control to heatmap toolbar, 2) compact pill with tooltip and help link, 3) presets (1,5,10) + slider for fine tuning, 4) keyboard + aria interaction doc, 5) low-sample hint with pattern + microcopy.
Kai: On copy variants: A) "View sampled data (X% of requests)" B) "Showing a sample: X% of requests" C) "Sampled view — X%" which reads best in a toolbar? My vote: C for brevity.
Pablo: C is compact but loses verb. maybe "Sampled view — X%" is balanced.
Ruth: Add an FAQ bullet: "Does sampling change exported metrics?" Answer: "Sampling affects rendered charts only; exports use full-resolution data if available or note the sampling in metadata."
Evan: One more thought: keyboard shortcuts for presets: Alt+1 Alt+5 Alt+0(for 10) ? might conflict. Maybe use single-key shortcuts when focus is inside the panel. document that.
DesignBot: Uploaded mock: https://redwood.test/uploads/ui/compact_sampler_toolbar_v3.png (shows pill, presets, slider, tiny help link).
Lina: Next steps: Pablo to write copy variants + help blurb; Ruth to mock low-sample patterns and run colorblind checks; Evan to add perf notes and skeleton plan; Kai to draft aria attributes.
Pablo: I'll post copy options in #design-drafts by EOD.
Ruth: I'll include screenshots from simulators.
Evan: I'll sync with infra tomorrow.
Kai: I'll draft an a11y checklist and test plan.
Lina: Can we review in the weekly design critique on Thursday?
DesignBot: Reminder: design critique scheduled Thu 11:30. :spiral_calendar: 
Lina: Thanks team!
